question: Approve the ideation design with D1 to D5 as recommended (at-most-once delivery; a per-project trigger repository holding only the ops workflow; the gate recorded on spacedock-state/ops; Netlify host with a plain Node adapter; one Node setup CLI with plan, apply and verify), the AC-3 and AC-4 wording changes D2 and D3 carry, setup also applying a restrict-creations ruleset that limits the agent App to ops/** and spacedock-state/ops in the project repository, and a path-filtered kc-ops-inbox test job in CI? Approving accepts all of these as written and enters implementation.

artifacts.summary: Read-only probe of GitHub's permission map shows no permission limits a credential to one workflow and Actions write also re-runs any run, so the inbox App is installed only on a per-project trigger repository holding one workflow (D2). The gate is recorded on the state branch so the Captain's approval is not dismissed (D3). Estimate 3 days, at the budget. Risk: the agent App can push any branch in the project repository, where push-triggered workflows run with its secrets; FO adds a restrict-creations ruleset to setup.
